# Discogs dump fixtures (synthetic)

Small files in the published Discogs monthly dump format, with **invented** artists, labels, titles
and ids (1xx artists, 2xx labels, 3xx masters, 4xx releases). They exercise the importer's parsing and
edge cases without copying any real Discogs data. `.gz` copies are generated by
`npm run fixtures:discogs` so the gzip streaming path is tested too.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `artists.xml` | real name, profile, URLs, name variations, aliases (with ids), a group with members, Unicode, `(2)` numbering, a minimal record, one record with no name (record-level error) |
| `labels.xml` | sublabels and parent label, contact info, a “Not On Label” style entry, companies that are also label ids |
| `masters.xml` | master with main release, several artists with join text, genres/styles, a master whose artist isn't imported |
| `releases.xml` | multiple artists & labels, multiple formats with descriptions, genres/styles, extra-artist credits (release and track level), companies with roles, headings, index tracks with sub-tracks, identifiers (barcode, matrix/runout, label code), videos, missing optional fields, unresolved master/artist/label references, 8-Track format, a duplicate release id, and invalid records (no title, non-numeric id) |
| `releases_v2.xml` | a later dump: one release changed, one unchanged, one new, one absent (must not be deleted) |
| `malformed.xml` | not well-formed XML (fatal) |
| `xxe.xml` | DOCTYPE with an external entity (refused, never resolved) |
